scope.operation: Fresh install and ordinary UI editing: Calculator 2 + 3 = 5; Notes keeps its default keyboard, operates only fully visible uncovered targets, saves through one normal HOME and reads after a new process launch. No automatic BACK.
scope.data: Synthetic arithmetic and distinct per-state note text only; no accounts or user files.
